claimsExtracted.text: createSPRT computes the accept-H0 (upper) decision boundary as log((1 - alpha) / beta) under the convention that the log-likelihood accumulator adds log(p0/p1) on success.
createSPRT computes the reject-H0 (lower) decision boundary as log(alpha / (1 - beta)) under the convention that the log-likelihood accumulator adds log(p0/p1) on success.

For alpha=0.05 and beta=0.20 (as produced by sprtConfigFromContract(0.90, 0.95)), createSPRT exposes upperBoundary and lowerBoundary values matching Wald's bounds: log((1-alpha)/beta) and log(alpha/(1-beta)) respectively.

For alpha=0.01 and beta=0.20 (as produced by sprtConfigFromContract(0.85, 0.99)), createSPRT exposes upperBoundary and lowerBoundary values matching Wald's bounds: log((1-alpha)/beta) and log(alpha/(1-beta)) respectively.

The SPRT boundary convention is corrected so that the accept-H0 boundary corresponds to the upper boundary and the reject-H0 boundary corresponds to the lower boundary for the existing likelihood-ratio accumulator convention (log(p0/p1) added on success).
